title: Past Counterfactuals in Ethical Judgements
grammar: Recap: *ha … volna*, and what *lett volna* adds
goal: I can say that a harm would have been avoidable if someone had acted (*Ha … volna, elkerülhető lett volna …*).
I can say that a duty was not met (*kötelessége lett volna*).
I can look back on a decision (*visszatekintve*, *más döntést kellett volna hozni*).

sections.title: Unit 9: Bioethics, Human Dignity & Moral Quandaries
body: This unit is about medical ethics: what a doctor or a hospital should have done, what is likely and what is a duty, hard choices, and the patient's right to decide.
The reading in lesson 5 is a text about the writer and physician László Németh and his essay *A minőség forradalma*.

I can say that a duty was not met (*kötelessége lett volna*).
I can look back on a decision (*visszatekintve*, *más döntést kellett volna hozni*).
